candidate: Use frozen RGB query features, bounded edge regression, and one-to-one training assignment for pedestrian and rider. Unassigned duplicates and mislocalized fragments are negatives. Keep parent detections and test additional boxes at confidence 0.60.
screen: Use both previous screens, additionally require a gain in simultaneous pedestrian and rider matches on eligible cycle pairs. No change to the model or operating point after evaluating these splits.
on_pass: Freeze the candidate and check the existing independent six-class development benchmark before a new holdout.
on_fail: Keep the frozen parent and report the mechanism limiting the overlap pairs.
